label.zh-TW: App Store：VoiceTube 看影片學英語

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟分享連結（voice.tube 短網址，分享文案沒有邀請碼）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the share link (a voice.tube short link; the share text has no code).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示開啟或下載 App，請只安裝 App 商店中的官方版本。
steps.en: Follow the page to open or download the app, and install only the official version from the app store.

steps.zh-TW: 開啟 App 後依指示註冊或登入 VoiceTube。
steps.en: Open the app and register or log in to VoiceTube as it directs.

intro.zh-TW: VoiceTube 看影片學英語 App 的分享連結；分享文案只有口號，沒有提到邀請碼或優惠。
intro.en: Share link for the VoiceTube English-learning app; the share text has only a slogan, no code or offer.

description.zh-TW:
VoiceTube 看影片學英語是以影片學習英文的服務，App 可免費下載，另有付費訂閱。依服務條款，未滿 20 歲須與法定代理人一起閱讀並同意條款。

本頁連結是分享文案中的 voice.tube 短網址，會轉到 VoiceTube 的 App 連結頁；分享文案沒有邀請碼，是否綁定邀請人未查證。分享文案沒有提到優惠，不列優惠。實際內容以官方公告為準。
description.en:
VoiceTube is an English-learning service built around videos. The app is free to download and offers paid subscriptions. Under the terms of use, users under 20 need their legal representative to read and agree to the terms with them.

The link on this page is the voice.tube short link from the share text; it leads to a VoiceTube app-link page; the share text gives no invite code, and whether the link is tied to a referrer was not checked. The share text is only a slogan and mentions no offer, so no offer is listed here. Actual terms follow the official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 分享文案只有口號，連結原樣保留。2026-10-24 以瀏覽器開啟，voice.tube 會轉到 applinks.voicetube.com 的 App 連結頁；voice.tube 是依轉址列入，本站讀到的 VoiceTube 頁面沒有提到它。註冊時邀請關係是否被接受，沒有測試。短網址的終點可由擁有者變更，請在繼續前確認最終網址。本站另有其他 VoiceTube 連結。
notes.en: The share text is only a slogan, and the link is kept exactly as shared. Opened in a browser on 2026-10-24, voice.tube redirected to an app-link page on applinks.voicetube.com; voice.tube is listed based on that redirect, and no VoiceTube page read here mentions it. Whether a referral is accepted at sign-up was not tested. The destination of a short link can be changed by its owner, so check the final address before continuing. This site also lists other VoiceTube links.

q.zh-TW: 這條 VoiceTube 分享連結需要輸入邀請碼嗎？
q.en: Do I need an invite code for this VoiceTube share link?

a.zh-TW: 本站沒有邀請碼可提供：分享文案沒有邀請碼，網址最後的 TVWmEHbg 是否為邀請碼，VoiceTube 沒有說明，所以不列為邀請碼。請直接透過本頁連結開啟。
a.en: This site has no invite code to give: the share text has none, and VoiceTube does not say whether the end of the address, TVWmEHbg, is a code, so it is not listed as one. Open the link on this page.

q.zh-TW: 透過這條連結註冊有優惠嗎？
q.en: Is there an offer for signing up through this link?

a.zh-TW: 分享文案沒有提到優惠，本站讀到的 VoiceTube 官方頁面也沒有說明這條連結的優惠，所以不列出優惠。
a.en: The share text mentions no offer, and the official VoiceTube pages read here describe none for this link, so none is listed.
